:::{#cor-mvn-mahalanobis}
#### The multivariate normal density decreases with Mahalanobis distance

If $\vX \sim \Normal_p\paren{\vecf{\mean}, \matr{\covmat}}$, then:

$$
\p(\vX = \vx) = \frac{1}{(2\pi)^{p/2} \det(\matr{\covmat})^{1/2}} \ef{-\frac{\mahal(\vx)^2}{2}}
$$

where $\mahal$ is the Mahalanobis distance to $\vecf{\mean}$ with respect to $\matr{\covmat}$ (@def-mahalanobis).
So the density is highest at $\vx = \vecf{\mean}$,
decreases as $\mahal(\vx)$ increases,
and is the same at every $\vx$ with the same $\mahal(\vx)$.

:::

::: proof

Substitute @def-mahalanobis into @def-mvn.
The function $\mahaldist \mapsto \ef{-\mahaldist^2/2}$ decreases on $\mahaldist \ge 0$,
and by @lem-mahalanobis-nonneg, $\mahal(\vx) = 0$ only at $\vx = \vecf{\mean}$.

:::
